questions.q: How did Commonwealth Bank of Australia adjust its stance on the domestic currency despite current spot market pressures?
o: Strategists revised their predictive frameworks upward following recent macroeconomic data prints, upgrading valuation projections.

questions.e: Commonwealth Bank of Australia revised its valuation path for the Australian dollar upward after strategists recalibrated predictive frameworks following recent macroeconomic data prints.
